title: Broken bleed line cuts F-18 control lines on Saudi Arabia training run
place_text: Saudi Arabia training range / aircraft carrier

tellings.quote: things. One of those had broken and it was essentially like a plasma beam just cutting things inside the jet.

plain: A Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a training flight near Saudi Arabia during his first squadron. He says a bleed line, a pipe carrying very hot air from the engine through his F-18 fighter jet, broke and acted "like a plasma beam", cutting through things inside the jet, including control lines. He tells it as an example of how dangerous ordinary flying can be.
